docs.title: Patch 2.3.0 Notes
docs.text:
Patch 2.3.0 is live! This update focuses on weapon balance, the Ranked map rotation and Siege lobbies. Servers were down for about 40 minutes during deployment.

WEAPONS

• Arc Lance: damage changed from 42 to 48.
• Void Pistol: magazine size changed from 12 to 10.
• Ember Bow: draw time changed from 900 ms to 750 ms.
• Frost Hammer: damage changed from 85 to 80.

ABILITIES

• Phantom Glaive: cooldown changed from 14 seconds to 18 seconds.

RANKED MAP ROTATION

• Glass Canyon has been added to the Ranked rotation.
• Echo Station has been removed from the Ranked rotation while the map is reworked.

MODES

• Siege: max players changed from 10 to 12.

BUG FIXES

• Fixed an issue where Ember Bow arrows could pass through closed doors.
• Fixed a crash when joining a Siege lobby from the friends list.
• Fixed the scoreboard showing the wrong team colors after a reconnect.
• Fixed missing footstep sounds on metal stairs.

Thank you for playing Ashen Frontier. See you on the frontier!

• Phantom Glaive 재사용 대기시간: 18초 → 22초
• Frost Hammer 피해량: 80 → 88

이벤트

• 수확 축제 이벤트가 2025년 10월 20일부터 2025년 11월 3일까지 진행됩니다.
• 이벤트 기간 동안 일일 미션 보상이 두 배로 지급됩니다.

버그 수정

• 일부 상황에서 관전 화면이 멈추는 문제를 수정했습니다.
• 한국어 자막이 일부 컷신에서 표시되지 않던 문제를 수정했습니다.

앞으로도 많은 관심 부탁드립니다.
